tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Find AI and software tools tracked on usedby by name, other product name, or what they do (category or topic, e.g. 'CRM', 'translation'), with how many companies publicly use each.

tools.name: who_uses
tools.description: Companies that publicly use a tool, strongest proof first, each with its proof level (CONFIRMED, OBSERVED, or SIGNAL: a job post, the weakest proof), source page and first public proof date.

tools.name: company_stack
tools.description: Tools a company publicly uses according to usedby, strongest proof first, each with its proof level (job-post signals last) and source page.

tools.name: recent_changes
tools.description: Companies newly listed as customers by tool vendors in the last N days, optionally for one tool. Departures are not published.

tools.name: compare
tools.description: Two tools side by side: public customers with their proof mix, top industries, companies confirmed or observed on both, and vendor facts with their sources.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_tools" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Find AI and software tools tracked on usedby by name or category, with how many companies publicly use each." → after: "Find AI and software tools tracked on usedby by name, other product name, or what they do (category or topic, e.g. 'CRM', 'translation'), with how many companies publicly use each."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
